title: Chuyên viên thương mại, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược, Đông Nam Á
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google tại Đông Nam Á (SEA) tiếp sức cho các doanh nghiệp hàng đầu nâng cao doanh thu kỹ thuật số trong bối cảnh thương mại ưu tiên AI. Khi hành trình mua sắm kỹ thuật số phát triển trên khắp các trang web thương mại, cửa hàng thực tế của thương hiệu và mạng lưới nhà xuất bản bên ngoài, nhóm của chúng tôi giúp các thương hiệu lớn trong lĩnh vực bán lẻ, hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói sẵn (CPG), công nghệ và bán hàng trực tiếp đến người tiêu dùng (D2C) nắm bắt lưu lượng nhu cầu của những khách hàng có ý định cao và tối đa hoá lợi tức đầu tư trực tuyến.

Nhóm Chuyên viên sản phẩm tập trung vào việc mang lại kết quả có thể đo lường và tối đa hoá lợi tức đầu tư cho khách hàng trên toàn bộ phễu tiếp thị bằng các giải pháp về đo lường, hiệu suất và quảng cáo thương hiệu.

Là một Chuyên viên thương mại, bạn sẽ đóng vai trò như một chuyên gia về khía cạnh thương mại cũng như chuyên gia về lĩnh vực thương mại trực tuyến và mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại (CMN) ở khắp Đông Nam Á. Bạn sẽ hợp tác với các nhà quảng cáo thương hiệu hàng đầu, nhà bán lẻ trực tuyến thuần tuý và nhà điều hành mạng lưới truyền thông để đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng công nghệ quảng cáo thương mại tiên tiến, cơ sở hạ tầng dữ liệu sản phẩm và các giải pháp tạo doanh thu từ đối tượng bên ngoài. Bạn sẽ chẩn đoán phễu chuyển đổi trực tuyến, thúc đẩy tốc độ giao dịch trên web/ứng dụng và trang web thương mại, đồng thời thúc đẩy các mục tiêu kinh doanh quan trọng cho đối tác của chúng tôi bằng các giải pháp của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Thúc đẩy các chiến lược thương mại trên các mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại, chiến dịch Tìm kiếm, Tạo nhu cầu và Tối đa hoá hiệu suất để đạt được các mục tiêu về GMV, ROAS và tỷ lệ thu nạp của khách hàng trên khắp Đông Nam Á.
  • Hợp tác với các nhà bán lẻ và trang web thương mại hàng đầu để thiết kế, mở rộng quy mô và tạo các giải pháp truyền thông thương mại bên ngoài nền tảng cho doanh nghiệp bằng cách sử dụng cơ sở hạ tầng quảng cáo và tín hiệu về đối tượng của Google.
  • Đẩy nhanh việc áp dụng các công cụ thương mại dựa trên AI của Google và hướng dẫn nhà quảng cáo về việc đặt giá thầu nâng cao, tích hợp dữ liệu của bên thứ nhất và cấu trúc chiến dịch toàn phễu.
  • Xây dựng kế hoạch kinh doanh chung, cẩm nang và khung thuyết trình để nâng cao kỹ năng cho các nhóm quản lý tài khoản của LCS và công ty quảng cáo về việc tạo doanh thu thương mại và mở rộng quy mô hiệu suất.
  • Đóng vai trò một chuyên gia ở khu vực về lĩnh vực truyền thông bán lẻ kỹ thuật số, tổng hợp các xu hướng thị trường ở Đông Nam Á để cung cấp thông tin và định hình lộ trình sản phẩm toàn cầu.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 5 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực mạng truyền thông bán lẻ (RMN/CMN), quảng cáo thương mại kỹ thuật số, thương mại video hoặc tiếp thị dựa trên hiệu suất trong một nền tảng thương mại điện tử hoặc hệ sinh thái công nghệ.
  • Kinh nghiệm làm việc với các thương hiệu hàng tiêu dùng đóng gói sẵn (CPG), trang web thương mại trực tuyến hoặc nhà bán hàng thương mại điện tử trực tuyến thuần tuý về việc lập kế hoạch truyền thông kỹ thuật số.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm thực tế về video có thể mua sắm, thương mại trực tiếp và hệ sinh thái thương mại trên mạng xã hội, thúc đẩy hành trình từ khám phá đến thanh toán trên toàn phễu.
  • Thành tích đã được chứng minh trong việc mở rộng quy mô các giải pháp quảng cáo thương mại trực tuyến, bao gồm cả quảng cáo được tài trợ tại chỗ, mạng lưới truyền thông thương mại (CMN) ngoài nền tảng hoặc các chương trình tạo doanh thu trên trang web thương mại.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Bahasa/tiếng Việt để trao đổi với các bên liên quan trong hoạt động kinh doanh.
  • Kỹ năng phân tích và giải quyết vấn đề tốt, có khả năng rút ra thông tin chi tiết hữu ích từ dữ liệu.
  • Kỹ năng giao tiếp và quản lý nhân sự xuất sắc, cùng khả năng tác động đến các bên liên quan ở mọi cấp bậc.

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Developer Technical Content, Cloud Product Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. From determining positioning, naming, competitive analysis, feature prioritization and external communications, you help shape the product and help it grow a consumer base. This means you work with a cross-functional team across Sales, corporate communications, legal, webmasters, product development, engineering and more. In this role, you'll be involved with product marketing strategy from beginning to end.

As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, Developer Technical Content, you will drive the strategic execution for how we educate and inspire the global builder community through high-quality, technical content. You will be at the forefront of the dramatic shift in how software is built and distributed, particularly in the era of AI. We are looking for a technical expert who can bridge the gap between product engineering and the builder community. You don't just execute the content coming out of product marketing organization; you craft narratives that resonate with skeptical technical audiences, prioritizing technical utility and trust over traditional marketing. You will act as a subject matter expert to define content strategy, craft compelling messaging, and create assets that help developers succeed with Google Cloud and AI products.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $171000 - $247000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive Technical Storytelling: Lead the creation of innovative technical demos, tutorials, and 'Hello World' experiences that help builders overcome adoption blockers.
  • Execute Global Content Strategy: Implement end-to-end technical content and go-to-market strategies for builders, ensuring a cohesive and high-impact presence.
  • Advocate for Builders: Influence product roadmaps by acting as a trusted partner to Engineering and Product teams, using feedback and technical expertise.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 9 years of experience in marketing.
  • Experience executing cross-functional projects and building partnerships with product and engineering teams.
  • Experience working in the developer ecosystem.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Passion for the developer community and understanding of builder motivations.

  • Proven track record in technical marketing, Developer Relations (DevRel), or technical advocacy, and ability to produce compelling product narratives and technical content for various formats (demos, video, social, blogs).

title: Data Center Technician II
descriptionHtml:
Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Finland: €58000 - €59000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across teams.
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose somewhat complex issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and applying the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for non-standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.
  • Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, within one or more teams.
  • Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with multiple solutions, separately.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience with assembly of mechanical or electrical systems, or performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on technical equipment.
  • Experience with diagnosing and troubleshooting operating systems, computer hardware and server hardware.
  • Experience with hardware and operating systems (e.g., Linux), and networking protocols.
  • Ability to lift/move 50lb (23kg) of equipment and ability to exert yourself physically over extended periods of time, including frequent bending, kneeling, climbing, pushing/pulling and lifting.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in maintenance and monitoring of server systems.
  • 3 years of experience working within a data center or network operation center environment.
  • Experience with performing component-level repairs and troubleshooting on IT equipment or in a similar role (e.g., Systems Administration, Network Deployment Engineer, Help Desk Technician, etc.).
  • Experience with Linux operating systems.
  • Experience in project management and leadership, and collaborating and partnering with teams.

title: Optical Transport Network Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

title: Senior Hardware Emulation Engineer, Google
descriptionHtml:
In this role, you’ll work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration. You will have an opportunity to drive cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers Google's most demanding AI/ML applications. You’ll be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's TPU. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide, and leverage your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems.

In this role, you will help develop and maintain emulation infrastructure, tools, and workflow methodologies supporting ASIC projects.You will help create ASICs representing a significant investment in time and money, and a successful prototyping campaign helps to ensure success of these critical projects. However, as designs continue to increase in size and complexity, emulation becomes even more important in meeting verification and bring-up milestones. You will provide excellent emulation infrastructure and methodologies essential to support these projects.

You will work directly with other emulation team members as well as designers, verification engineers, and software teams. You will compile complex projects targeting our platforms, bring up high-speed interfaces, debug issues across design and infrastructure, and help drive pre-silicon and lab bring-up and validation of our ASIC systems.
The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build, compile, and debug full-chip and multi-die System-on-Chip (SoC) RTL models and tests on hardware emulation platforms.
  • Bring up external interfaces (e.g., PCIe, HBM, DDR5, UCIe, Ethernet, USB) on emulation platforms using transactors, Accelerated VIPs, and speed bridges.

title: Technical Program Manager III, Security and Firmware, Platforms and Devices
descriptionHtml:
Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. Fuchsia is Google's open-source, capability-based operating system, built on the Zircon microkernel and shipping on Google Nest devices. Our Security, Privacy, and Firmware program makes sure every product built on Fuchsia boots and updates reliably, is secure by design, and respects user privacy. The work spans the bootloader and verified boot, trusted execution environments, OS hardening, vulnerability response, and privacy reviews for every platform release. We partner with Android, product teams, Legal, and silicon vendors, and much of the platform is developed in the open at fuchsia.dev.

Fuchsia is a modern, open source operating system that is simple, secure, updatable, and performant. It’s a general purpose OS, designed to power an ecosystem of hardware and software, and provides core operating system functions like system resource management, a driver framework, and software abstractions.

As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

France: €104000 - €106000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a large, site-wide data center construction and delivery organization, managing scopes related to construction projects or capital improvement projects.
  • Be responsible for ensuring the development of detailed designs, managing construction (delivery, cost, quality and EHS), commissioning, close-out and hand-off to the operations team. Ensure all customer requirements are being met.
  • Establish and maintain various delivery models and global relationships with multiple vendors.
  • Create a growth plan and be involved in hiring/recruiting of talent in the areas of project management, field engineering, document control, technical writing, etc.
  • Research and implement construction means and methods of data center equipment and facilities. Carry design concepts into mass production and integrate into facilities.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in program management.
  • Experience in the construction field.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Construction Management or equivalent industry experience.
  • 5 years of experience in construction programs and project delivery of mission-critical facilities over the full project lifecycle.
  • Experience with data center equipment/environments, including switchgear, generators, chillers, cooling towers, air handling units, controls, security monitoring systems, and fire safety systems.
  • Experience with commercial negotiations, contractor procurement and mobilization into delivery.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, with an understanding of standard practices in the design and construction industry.

title: Technical Solutions Consultant, Measurement Foundations (Polish, English)
descriptionHtml:
As a Center of Excellence within the gTech Ads Solution team, our mission is to empower Large Customer Sales (LCS) clients to achieve business outcomes through data-driven measurement.

In this specific team, you will partner with clients, agencies, and internal gTech/Sales teams, providing scaled, support to build measurement readiness, including assessing and preparing clients to implement infrastructure, identify data gaps, enhance data collection, and accurately track performance against key indicators. Your ultimate goal is to enable clients to maximize value from Google's products and shape the future of measurement.

You will serve as a technical expert on Google's measurement products, working with Large Customer Sales clients to assess their readiness, identify gaps, and implement solutions at scale. Your role involves close collaboration with clients, agencies, and internal teams.
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Ireland: €90000 - €92000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Discover customer measurement needs by understanding clients annual and quarterly issues/goals.
  • Analyze existing third-party partner landscape and measurement tech infrastructure of clients in a privacy-safe manner.
  • Participate in ideation, design and delivery of joint services plan.
  • Act as a consulting partner for ads measurement and data ingestion needs.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3 years of experience in technical support for web technologies in a customer-facing role.
  • Experience working with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Chrome Dev Tools, and working with APIs.
  • Experience in troubleshooting implementation issues, such as diagnosing critical product bugs affecting data flow.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Polish fluently to support client relationship management in this region.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a technical field.
  • Experience setting up Enhanced Conversions (EC), Google Analytics (GA4), Consent Mode, and Tagging (including server-side tagging and API integrations).
  • Experience advising internal and external stakeholders (like developer teams) on the end-to-end process life-cycle.
  • Deep understanding of Google and competitor ads products, as well as the broader privacy-safe measurement landscape.

title: Government Affairs and Public Policy Specialist (English, Spanish)
descriptionHtml:
As a member of Google’s Government Affairs and Public Policy team, you will engage externally and internally on behalf of Google. You will have strong investigative, organizational, and communication skills to manage multiple projects and respond to policy challenges effectively. You will be part of a global government affairs team, working across regions, product areas, and functions. You will combine creativity and intellectual excellence with the organizational skills to manage various campaigns, projects and initiatives.


In this role, you will advocate for Google to bring external perspectives back into the company to inform our perception and direction. You will be passionate about the opportunity to shape the future of how we use and build technology for everyone.

Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Legal, Marketing, Trust and Safety, and PR and other cross functional and business teams to integrate public policy priorities directly into product development and regional launches and execute local programs.
  • Represent Google before policymakers, industry peers, and key opinion formers to shape emerging dialogue on responsible technology policy.
  • Monitor, research, and analyze regional policy issues; design and execute comprehensive advocacy campaigns with clear, actionable goals.
  • Identify emerging legislative trends, evaluate their potential impact on Google’s users and business, and craft proactive solutions.
  • Support the development and execution of policy strategies in the country, working closely with more senior policy colleagues.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in policy analysis and campaigns, working on technology issues or the policy environments that surround them.
  • 4 years of experience working within government, think tanks, public interest groups, technology industry groups, or corporate public policy organizations.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Spanish fluently to engage with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Deep domain expertise and strong business acumen, with a proven ability to seamlessly integrate public policy with corporate business strategy.
  • Track record of leading and delivering cross-functional projects from inception to completion.
  • Experience in technology policy issues.
  • Strong and effective communicator and project manager.
  • Ability to operate in a changing, multi-stakeholder environment and exercise good judgment.

title: Data and AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Google Cloud Consulting Professional Services team guides customers through the moments that matter most in their cloud journey to help businesses thrive. We help customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers, and software infrastructure. As part of an innovative team in this rapidly growing business, you will help shape the future of businesses of all sizes and use technology to connect with customers, employees, and partners.

As a Strategic Cloud Data Engineer, you will guide customers on how to ingest, store, process, analyze, and explore/visualize data on the Google Cloud Platform. You will work on data migrations and modernization projects, and with customers to design large-scale data processing systems, develop data pipelines optimized for scaling, and troubleshoot potential platform/product challenges. You will have an in-depth understanding of data governance and security controls. You will travel to customer sites to deploy solutions and deliver workshops to educate and empower customers. Additionally, you will work closely with Product Management and Product Engineering teams to build and constantly drive excellence in our products.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Interact with stakeholders to translate complex customer requirements into recommendations for appropriate solution architectures and advisory  services.
  • Engage with technical leads, and partners to lead high velocity migration and modernisation to Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Design, migrate/build and operationalise data storage and processing infrastructure using Cloud native products.
  • Develop and implement data quality and governance procedures to ensure the accuracy and reliability of data.
  • Take various project requirements and organize them into clear goals and objectives, and create a work breakdown structure to manage internal and external stakeholders.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in developing and troubleshooting data processing algorithms and software (e.g., Python, Java, Scala, Spark, Hadoop).
  • Experience building machine learning or data science solutions.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in working with data warehouses, including data warehouse technical architectures, infrastructure components, ETL/ELT and reporting/analytic tools, environments, and data structures.
  • Experience in Big Data, information retrieval, data mining, or Machine Learning.
  • Experience in building multi-tier, high availability applications with modern technologies such as NoSQL, MongoDB, SparkML, and TensorFlow.
  • Understanding of database type, with the ability to write complex SQLs.
  • Understanding of distributed data processing frameworks and modern age GCP analytical and transactional data stores like BigQuery, CloudSQL, AlloyDB etc.
  • Understanding of core AI/ML concepts and frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Full Stack
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Write and test product or system development code.
  • Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.
  • Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
  • Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in object-oriented programming with Java, C++ or Python.
  • 5 years of experience programming in JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • 5 years of experience with front-end frameworks, full-stack development, or API development.
  • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products.
  • 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.
  • 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • Experience developing accessible technologies.

title: Trưởng ngành hàng, Ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, thấu hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và chuyển hoá những nhu cầu đó thành các giải pháp hiệu quả, giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu tham vọng nhất. Bạn phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội ngũ bán hàng để cùng gặt hái thành công, góp phần định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo ra những tác động thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.


Khi đảm nhận vai trò này, bạn sẽ định hướng và dẫn dắt nhóm bán hàng và các phòng ban liên ngành để thúc đẩy một hệ sinh thái đang phát triển cho Google tại Việt Nam. Bạn sẽ cộng tác và phối hợp liên ngành, xuyên quốc gia để hợp thành một nhóm phụ trách từng khách hàng chiến lược trong ngành Trò chơi và Ứng dụng, nhằm phát triển các mối quan hệ chiến lược, lâu dài và đôi bên cùng có lợi.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách chào bán một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Xây dựng lộ trình, chiến lược và dẫn dắt đội ngũ triển khai hiệu quả nhằm khai phá trọn vẹn tiềm năng từ những khách hàng chiến lược hàng đầu. Thấu hiểu sâu sắc nhu cầu kinh doanh của các nhà quảng cáo trong ngành, đồng thời cung cấp thông tin chi tiết về hành vi tiêu dùng liên quan nhằm đưa ra những sáng kiến thúc đẩy tăng trưởng.
  • Tạo và triển khai các chiến lược tăng trưởng kinh doanh, kế hoạch hằng năm và kế hoạch phát triển khách hàng, cũng như quy trình kinh doanh cho ngành dọc mà mình phụ trách. Thiết lập và duy trì mối quan hệ chặt chẽ với các nhà quản lý cấp cao của các khách hàng và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu, đồng thời thúc đẩy việc ứng dụng các giải pháp của Google.
  • Xây dựng và quản lý một nhóm có thành tích cao để mang đến những giải pháp chuyên sâu, tập trung vào doanh nghiệp, đồng thời tạo dựng văn hoá đổi mới hoạt động kinh doanh và hướng tới sự thành công của khách hàng cho cả nhóm. Huấn luyện, khuyến khích, truyền cảm hứng và phát triển một nhóm gồm các Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Quản lý khách hàng chiến lược cũng như nguồn nhân lực phối hợp liên ngành.
  • Đại diện cho Google với vai trò là diễn giả chủ chốt tại các sự kiện trong ngành, phát triển thương hiệu của Google và xác định đối tác tiềm năng.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 11 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực bán giải pháp quảng cáo, tiếp thị kỹ thuật số, tư vấn hoặc truyền thông.
  • Có kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quản lý nhân viên.
  • Có khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để giao tiếp và phục vụ các bên liên quan trọng yếu.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Kinh nghiệm lãnh đạo nhóm bán hàng, quản lý các nhóm có thành tích cao, cũng như thúc đẩy tăng trưởng mang tính đột phá.
  • Kinh nghiệm quản lý và tác động đến ban lãnh đạo hoặc quản lý cấp cao thuộc phía khách hàng và các bên liên quan.
  • Kinh nghiệm xây dựng thương hiệu vững chắc và khả năng phối hợp cùng các đối tác nội bộ lẫn bên ngoài đến từ nhiều nền văn hoá và khu vực địa lý.
  • Kinh nghiệm lãnh đạo tư tưởng và tạo dựng các mối quan hệ uy tín cả trong nội bộ lẫn bên ngoài, cũng như khả năng tác động đến những quyết định trọng yếu và thúc đẩy sự đồng thuận về các ưu tiên chính.
  • Khả năng mang lại kết quả trong một tổ chức đa quốc gia theo mô hình ma trận.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Products and Systems, Google Photos
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a collaborative Staff Software Engineer, you will help build both our flagship agent features and the engineering foundation behind them. In this role, you will act as a technical anchor for a small, full-stack team—working side-by-side with UX and fellow engineers to take new proactive and background agent projects from early prototypes to live user experiments in weeks rather than quarters. At the same time, you will partner across Photos and Gemini teams to design and own the scalable production backend systems that allow proven experiments to graduate cleanly and run reliably at Google Photos scale.

Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship 0-to-1 agent features end-to-end, including proactive agents that surface timely suggestions to users and long-running background agents that retrieve photos, run goal models item by item, and organize a user's library into dynamic spaces.
  • Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines. Coach a distributed team of engineers.
  • Partner closely with UX, PM, and teammates to turn rough ideas into working prototypes on real photo data, and collaborate with other Photos and Gemini teams to bring validated features into the main app.
  • Design and own the 1-to-100 production backend systems needed to take successful experiments to 100M+ users without a full rewrite, covering async task execution, state streaming, data/byte permissions, and tool/MCP interfaces.
  • Work across the client and server stack to ship faster updates to live experiments.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience programming in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin or Go.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
  • 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures/algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

title: Engineering Manager, Node Performance Team
descriptionHtml:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

Compute Infrastructure is the class-defining cluster management system that plays a key role in enabling Google's tremendous growth and innovation.

In this role, you are responsible for designing and analyzing computer systems and their interactions with the kernel, hardware, cluster software, and Borg users. You will partner with technical leaders within and outside of the compute infrastructure organization to build and align the team's roadmap. You will drive the team's planning and strategy as well as own execution against the roadmap. You will also build and maintain a healthy team culture based on collaboration, innovation, and doing the right thing.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Generative AI, Google Research
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Software Engineer on the Performance Simulation team, you will design and develop simulation software and AI-driven platforms that model how AI workloads (e.g., Gemini, MoE thinking/reasoning models, long-context serving) execute on applicant hardware architectures.

Operating at the critical boundary between frontier ML models and future accelerator roadmaps, you will build and automate cycle-level and analytical performance estimators to project throughput, latency SLOs, and Perf/TCO across different silicon configurations (SRAM/HBM hierarchies, multi-dimensional ICI interconnects, optical switching, and specialized compute engines like SparseCore). You will integrate LLM-driven agentic workflows to automate sweep generation, parameter exploration, data retrieval, and bottleneck diagnosis—accelerating hardware/software decisions.

Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $174000 - $252000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable performance simulation frameworks to accurately evaluate training and serving metrics for next-generation TPU configurations.
  • Model how future model architectures (e.g., Mixture-of-Experts, multi-head latent attention, hybrid sequence parallelism, sparse attention, and KV-cache compression) interact with architectural variables (e.g., SRAM capacity/bandwidth, HBM contention, ICI network topologies, and live failover mechanisms).
  • Develop and integrate AI-agentic platforms and toolchains to automate simulator sweep setup, parameter sensitivity analyses, and data extraction over gigabytes of simulation sweeps—reducing analysis cycles from weeks to hours.
  • Build analytical and optimization engines (e.g., Mixed-Integer Programming/MIP, simulated annealing, roofline estimation) to identify Pareto-optimal execution strategies (sharding, tensor placement, weight pinning, prefetching).
  • Formulate clear, data-grounded performance projections and comparative studies (e.g., Iso-execution analysis, trade-off studies between compute density versus memory bandwidth) to inform multi-year TPU platform roadmaps and hardware contracts.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of software engineering (e.g., C++ and Python).
  • Experience with computer architecture concepts (memory hierarchies, roofline models, bandwidth versus compute bottlenecks, network topologies).
  • Experience with software design for simulation, performance modeling, or scientific computing.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience designing LLM-based agentic orchestration loops (e.g., autonomous tool calling, multi-turn reasoning, self-correcting execution) or applying AI to automated software engineering, hardware/compiler optimization, or simulation workflows.
  • Experience with performance profiling tools, analytical roofline modeling, or architectural simulators.
  • Knowledge of modern transformer architectures (Dense and MoE, long-context attention, speculative decoding) and distributed execution paradigms (SPMD, pipeline, tensor, and expert parallelism) across modern ML frameworks (e.g., JAX, PyTorch/XLA, or Pallas).
  • Ability to bridge high-level model specifications with low-level hardware constraints (interconnect latency, SRAM caching, DMA scheduling).

Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The Google Health team is building products and services that empower our consumers to live a longer, healthier life. We do this by building the best of Google’s technologies and foundational AI models into consumer experiences focused on health and wellness, which are intuitive, credible, actionable and deeply personal, helping users understand their health and support them in taking proactive actions to improve their long-term health.

As a Product Manager, you will be pivotal in scaling Health Guardian, our longitudinal and proactive health solution, by bridging cutting-edge physiological AI research with high-reliability health data pipelines, clinical validation workflows, and launch-ready consumer health features.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive strategy to scale up health data integration for the Google Health app to enable more personalized and helpful Health Coach experiences.
  • Enable scaling of the Health Guardian feature integration with Google Health coach, to help users understand their health and get personalized recommendations for next steps.
  • Shephard core health guardian features and drive new novel development to expand Health Guardian features.
  • Lead the product strategy and execution for longitudinal data collection efforts to support novel health discovery, including leading large scale research study, designing thoughtful and engaging user experiences to ensure high quality data collection.
  • Partner with other Product Managers and cross-functional teams to accelerate validation speed while upholding rigorous clinical, legal, privacy, and safety guardrails.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  • 2 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc).
  • Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.
  • Experience in product management, with a focus on building consumer app platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a relevant technical or health field.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams, with strong technical, analytical, and collaboration skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and balance resources across teams, while ensuring milestones are met on time and with high quality.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts and drive alignment across various stakeholders (Product Managers, Researchers, Engineers, and Raters).
  • Demonstrated success in solving ambiguous problems, challenging the status quo, and creating innovative, successful consumer-facing products.

title: Global Product Lead, Support Tools, Global Business Applied AI, GTM
descriptionHtml:

title: Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, Ngành Game, Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (tiếng Anh, tiếng Việt)
locations: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
descriptionHtml:
Doanh nghiệp thuộc mọi loại hình và quy mô tin tưởng vào các giải pháp quảng cáo vượt trội của Google để tăng trưởng trong môi trường tiếp thị năng động hiện nay. Bạn lan toả niềm đam mê bán hàng, sự hiểu biết về truyền thông trực tuyến và lòng quyết tâm giúp khách hàng đạt được thành công lớn nhất. Bạn hành động với tinh thần làm chủ, nhanh nhạy thích ứng với mọi thay đổi, tìm kiếm những cách thức mới mang tính chiến lược để liên tục đem đến kết quả ấn tượng và ngày một tốt hơn cho cả Google và khách hàng. Bạn xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy với khách hàng, tìm hiểu nhu cầu kinh doanh của họ và dựa vào đó để xây dựng các giải pháp hiệu quả giúp khách hàng đạt được những mục tiêu lớn lao nhất. Bạn gặt hái thành công cùng đội ngũ bán hàng, định hình tương lai của ngành quảng cáo trong kỷ nguyên AI và tạo dấu ấn thực sự đối với hàng triệu công ty cũng như hàng tỷ người dùng đặt trọn niềm tin vào Google cho những mục tiêu quan trọng nhất.

Với vai trò là Quản lý ngành hàng chiến lược, bạn sẽ là người đặt nền móng cho đà tăng trưởng có chiến lược, xây dựng mối quan hệ hợp tác đáng tin cậy với các bên liên quan cấp cao để thống nhất về các mục tiêu kinh doanh đầy tham vọng. Bạn sẽ khai thác sức mạnh của AI tạo sinh và phân tích dự đoán để định hướng những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành, giành chiến thắng nhờ giá trị độc đáo và tối đa hoá tác động để chứng minh sự thành công lâu dài của các đối tác.

Ở vai trò này, bạn sẽ là đối tác chiến lược và cố vấn đáng tin cậy cho các nhà phát triển trò chơi và ứng dụng hàng đầu tại Việt Nam, giúp họ mở rộng quy mô và thành công trên trường quốc tế. Bạn sẽ quản lý và thắt chặt các mối quan hệ ở cấp điều hành, định hình cách Google hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái tăng trưởng mạnh mẽ này trên toàn cầu.

Nhiệm vụ cốt lõi của bạn là thúc đẩy tăng trưởng kinh doanh cho khách hàng bằng cách tận dụng Chiến dịch quảng cáo ứng dụng và Hệ sinh thái ứng dụng của Google, đồng thời khai thác các cơ hội đổi mới giữa các sản phẩm để mang lại kết quả kinh doanh vượt trội và có thể đo lường.

Các nhóm thuộc Khối Khách hàng chiến lược (LCS) của Google là đối tác chiến lược và chuyên gia đầu ngành hỗ trợ các thương hiệu và công ty quảng cáo hàng đầu thế giới. Chúng tôi không ngừng khuyến khích khách hàng nhìn nhận lại hoạt động kinh doanh của họ và khám phá những cách Google có thể hỗ trợ họ tăng trưởng. Chúng tôi tập trung vào việc giúp các khách hàng này thích ứng với những thay đổi sâu sắc trong ngành và thúc đẩy hiệu suất kinh doanh vượt trội bằng cách cung cấp một cách cạnh tranh trọn bộ giải pháp quảng cáo của Google trên Tìm kiếm, YouTube, Đo lường và nhiều nền tảng khác. Là một thành viên trong nhóm LCS, bạn sẽ có cơ hội đặc biệt để kinh doanh ở vị trí tiên phong của công nghệ, làm việc với ban điều hành, tác động đến các chiến lược định hình thị trường và tạo ra kết quả rõ rệt, có ảnh hưởng đáng kể đến các doanh nghiệp lớn trên toàn cầu, cũng như thúc đẩy sự tăng trưởng của Google.

Responsibilities

  • Tương tác và tạo sức ảnh hưởng đến những người ra quyết định chủ chốt, bao gồm cả ban lãnh đạo cấp cao, xây dựng mối quan hệ đáng tin cậy để thấu hiểu các thách thức cốt lõi và ưu tiên chiến lược trong hoạt động kinh doanh của họ.
  • Dẫn dắt quá trình phát triển kế hoạch kinh doanh chung, thống nhất với khách hàng về các mục tiêu đầy tham vọng và xác lập trách nhiệm chung để mở ra các cơ hội tăng trưởng mang tính đột phá.
  • Thiết kế và thuyết trình về các giải pháp mạnh mẽ, dựa trên dữ liệu của Google được điều chỉnh theo nhu cầu của khách hàng, tận dụng kiến thức chuyên sâu về các giải pháp quảng cáo của Google và cách kể chuyện lôi cuốn, đồng thời xử lý hiệu quả các ý kiến trái chiều để thu hút đầu tư và vượt chỉ tiêu doanh số.
  • Thể hiện rõ giá trị của Google bằng cách đối chiếu kết quả chiến dịch so với mục tiêu của khách hàng và giải pháp của đối thủ cạnh tranh, đồng thời chia sẻ thông tin chi tiết dựa trên dữ liệu để định hình chiến lược của khách hàng và củng cố mối quan hệ đối tác.
  • Chịu trách nhiệm thúc đẩy đà tăng trưởng của khách hàng bằng cách chủ động xác định và phát triển nguồn cơ hội mới dồi dào, tận dụng thông tin chi tiết và thành công đã được chứng minh để mở rộng mối quan hệ đối tác.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 8 năm kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực quảng cáo kỹ thuật số, tư vấn bán hàng, phát triển kinh doanh hoặc tiếp thị kỹ thuật số.
  • Khả năng giao tiếp thông thạo bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt để phục vụ khách hàng nói tiếng Việt.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Có kinh nghiệm làm việc trong ngành trò chơi/ứng dụng, truyền thông, phát triển kinh doanh, tiếp thị hoặc tư vấn bán hàng.
  • Có kinh nghiệm và đạt được thành công trong việc phát triển và duy trì những khách hàng được quản lý có giá trị cao, phức tạp theo hướng chiến lược thông qua phương pháp tư vấn.
  • Kiến thức về các sản phẩm quảng cáo của Google trên Ứng dụng, Video, Mạng Hiển thị và Tìm kiếm.
  • Có khả năng vận dụng những cách tiếp cận sáng tạo để phát triển giải pháp qua dữ liệu.
  • Có kỹ năng tổ chức, giải quyết vấn đề, tạo sự ảnh hưởng và thuyết trình xuất sắc.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Google Cloud Storage, AI/ML
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google Cloud's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. You will anticipate our customer needs and be empowered to act like an owner, take action and innovate. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

As a Storage Staff Software Engineer in the datapath team, you will design and implement advanced storage solutions tailored for AI/ML workloads on Google Cloud Platform. You will address complex system design challenges, develop production-ready code, and contribute to fast-paced incubation projects. Your role involves developing benchmarks, resolving performance issues and collaborating with cross-functional teams to bridge storage infrastructure with evolving AI/ML demands, from training to inference.
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement high-complexity features, delivering robust, production-ready code for storage solutions that address the specific demands of AI/ML workloads.
  • Architect scalable and performant storage solutions, driving the technical design for features and making data-driven decisions to optimize system efficiency and reliability.
  • Adapt to fast-paced development cycles for new technical domains.
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks and intricate system issues, developing innovative, practical solutions to technical challenges that arise at the intersection of storage and machine learning.
  • Partner with product and engineering stakeholders across the storage domain to deliver high-complexity features and products.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience developing performance oriented storage solutions, including datapath modules.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 8 years of experience in software development, and with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization including technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional or cross-business projects.

title: Data Center Server Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we aim to foster Googley work environments that are collaborative, friendly and fun. The Facilities Management team brings our spaces to life as you oversee the daily operations of our offices. While roles with similar names at other companies can be far more mundane, you're a creative, organized customer service specialist, who takes pride in seeing things run smoothly and efficiently. You go out of your way to make sure that clients are not only satisfied, but singing Google's praises. You're comfortable in a fast-paced environment with the highest standards of excellence. You aren't afraid to have fun with your job, and bring an enthusiasm, dedication and a collaborative spirit to build and maintain office spaces that facilitate some of the world's most cutting edge innovation.

The Global Server Operations team is responsible for monitoring the physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As a Hardware Operations Manager, you will manage a team of Data Center Technicians. You will oversee the quality installation of server hardware and components and take charge of complicated installations/troubleshooting.

In this role, you will manage a technical team and oversee data centers and facility operations to meet organizational goals and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Key responsibilities include hiring, coaching, and developing staff, setting team priorities, and partnering with stakeholders to implement short- and long-term strategies. You will execute security and operational procedures, analyze trends for improvement, and perform preventative maintenance and repairs on equipment and infrastructure.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $164000 - $237000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the day-to-day management of teams within data center operations.
  • Communicate priorities and facilitate hand off of operations to following shift leads.
  • Work together to identify and resolve problems and create solutions for our global computing and network architecture.
  • Hire, coach, and develop a team while achieving business goals.
  • Ensure data center-related priorities are consistent with company objectives. Implement and drive the safety culture at the site, while fostering a collaborative team environment.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience managing technical teams in charge of installing, configuring, testing, troubleshooting, or maintaining hardware servers and its components.
  • Experience in site-level data center operational leadership.
  • Experience in a people management, supervision, or team leadership role.
  • Experience with different operating systems (e.g., Linux). Experience with developing network architecture.
  • Ability to work non-standard hours, including working weekends, night shifts, holidays and on shift-based schedules as required.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience leading and improving Environmental, Health, and Safety initiatives.
  • Experience with initiating and executing initiatives in a global environment.
  • Experience working in data center environments, including building and operating large-scale infrastructure, and network and compute architecture and lifecycle, and Linux/Unix system administration.
  • Ability to implement and drive the safety culture at the site, while fostering a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

title: YouTube Industry Manager, LCS
descriptionHtml:
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.

As an Industry Manager, you will be an architect of strategic growth, forging trusted alliances with C-level stakeholders to align on ambitious business goals. You will harness the power of generative AI and predictive analytics to navigate profound industry shifts, winning with unique value and maximizing impact to prove the long-term success of our partners.

In this role, you will leverage your business judgement to identify, educate, and engage customers with YouTube's latest advertising products and technologies. Utilizing influencing and relationship-building skills, you will provide Google-caliber client service, research, and market analysis, anticipating how decisions are made, understanding the details of individual campaigns, and persistently exploring, and uncovering the business needs of key business lines. Alongside our customers, you will set the goal and strategy for how their advertising can reach users.Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain relationships with prospective YouTube buyers in clients, agencies, and other key stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives,  while working in partnership with the Primary IM.
  • Lead and develop competitive pitches to accelerate adoption of YouTube and Branding solutions to grow YouTube and Branding business/ improving marketing results with key customers and own campaigns end-to-end.
  • Partner with relevant internal and external teams to analyze and optimize YouTube investments in the context of overall marketing ROI, making data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Oversee and coordinate with client/agency partners, ensuring effective communication, collaboration, and utilization of resources to drive successful marketing initiatives on YouTube and Branding solutions.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and innovations in digital marketing, providing insights and recommendations to keep the team and clients at the forefront of the evolving marketing landscape.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of industry experience in advertising, consultative sales, business development, or IT, or 6 years of experience with an advanced degree.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in managing complex stakeholder relationships.
  • Experience in cross-functional project management.
  • Experience in developing relationships with and selling to executive-level stakeholders.
  • Understanding of cross-functional media and branding businesses and operations.
  • Understanding of video/YouTube and social advertising in APAC.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills.

title: Technical Lead, Hardware Engineering, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Google's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

As the Technical Engineering Lead in Hardware Engineering, you will pioneer innovative, high-impact engineering solutions, mentor and develop a team to deliver efficiencies for the next generation of Google’s data center infrastructure. You will provide cross-functional leadership, partnering with multidisciplinary teams of electrical, mechanical, firmware, software, and thermal engineers. You will drive an end-to-end technical strategy, identifying high-value opportunities, guiding executive decision-making, and delivering transformative programs from concept to global deployment. You will be navigating complex ambiguity, fostering technical excellence, and making data-motivated decisions that shape foundational infrastructure.

Our Platforms Infrastructure Engineering team designs and builds the
hardware and software technologies that power all of Google's services. Our computational challenges are complex and unique, enabled by cutting-edge custom hardware designed and made in-house. As a hardware engineer, you will design and build the systems that are the heart of the world's largest and most powerful computing infrastructure. You will see those systems from concept all the way through to high-volume manufacturing. Your work has the potential to shape the machinery that goes into our cutting-edge data centers, affecting millions of Google users.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $188000 - $274000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end system architecture, technology roadmap, and board-level design for next-generation platforms, establishing technical direction and design standards.
  • Lead multi-disciplinary trade-off analyses across system, mechanical, thermal, and PCB layout teams to define high-density interconnect strategy, stackup architecture, and routing guidelines.
  • Architect Power Delivery Networks (PDN) and high-speed signal pathways with SI/PI experts, establishing guidelines that ensure robust performance at hyperscale.
  • Lead execution and technical design reviews with JDM/CM partners, implementing engineering changes to accelerate project delivery.
  • Lead cross-functional engineering initiatives with Silicon, Firmware, Software, Thermal, Mechanical, and Operations teams to deliver cohesive, scalable infrastructure solutions. Influence manufacturing and vendor roadmaps to optimize design for manufacturing and design for test for high-volume, enterprise-grade deployments.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6 years of experience working in a hardware systems development environment.
  • Experience in full product life cycle from design through deployment.
  • Experience leading JDM/CM partnerships and design review.
  • Experience driving system level architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field.
  • 10 years of engineering experience, with an understanding of data center technical environments.
  • Experience with data center equipment development.
  • Experience managing eCAD tools, workflows development. Experience overseeing lab validation strategy, hardware system bring-up, and root-cause analysis for complex debugging.
  • Experience managing a technical team.
  • Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to streamline individual, business or development workflows.

title: Senior Engineer, AI Productivity Team
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

title: Software Engineer III, Machine Learning Compiler, TPU Scaling
descriptionHtml:

Our team develops the ML Compiler (XLA) for running workloads on thousands of TPU, GPU or other accelerators. Accelerated Linear Algebra (XLA) powers all Google’s internal ML workloads and is a preferred choice for external foundational model producers and researchers for its advanced performance, usability and open source nature. As part of the team, you will be developing the compiler's ability to generate efficient communication on TPU. Your team will develop the compiler's horizontal scaling stack including collective op lowering, hiding communication latency, program sharding and more. Together these make it possible to train and serve the world's largest models efficiently on TPU.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. descriptionHtml:

You will manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize recovery time from failures. title: Product Manager, Google Drive — Next Billion Agents (Agent Platform and Governance)
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

Google Drive crossed a billion human users; our next billion users will be AI agents. We are on a mission to transition Drive from a static repository of files into an active execution partner and the context, storage, and governance bedrock of the agent era.

On the Next Billion Agents pillar, we treat first-party and third-party agents as first-class users while keeping humans safely in control. As work shifts from single documents to multi-file trees and parallel agentic workflows, our team builds the foundational rails that let humans and agents collaborate at machine speed: Drive’s model context protocol platform and semantic retrieval, multiplayer agent attribution and comment collaboration, least-privilege folder sandboxing, agent skills and project extensibility, and rich HTML/Markdown artifact experiences.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
